candidate.question:
The score chart gives these recorded groups and numbers of students:
Score group | Students
0-19 | 40
20-39 | 80
40-49 | 100
60-69 | 40
70-100 | 20
How many students took the examination?
candidate.explanation: Add the frequencies of all five recorded groups: 40 + 80 + 100 + 40 + 20 = 280. This gives the total number of students in the chart.
